TITLE: Gazpacho de melocoton
DESCRIPTION: Gazpacho de melocoton con tomate triturado, melocoton, ajo, pimiento, cebolla, aceite de oliva, vinagre de manzana y sal. Triturar los ingredientes hasta obtener una sopa fria suave y ajustar acidez y sal al gusto.

TITLE: Gofres de cacao sin gluten
DESCRIPTION: Gofres de cacao sin gluten preparados mezclando los ingredientes en un bol hasta conseguir una masa homogenea. Cocinar en moldes de silicona al microondas o en gofrera y enfriar antes de servir.

TITLE: Mandorle e nocciole al cioccolato
DESCRIPTION: Dolcetti italiani con mandorle, nocciole tostate e cioccolato fondente. Tostare la frutta secca, sciogliere il cioccolato a bagnomaria, mescolare tutto e formare piccoli mucchietti su carta forno.

TITLE: Pasta fresca agli spinaci con due ingredienti
DESCRIPTION: Pasta fresca verde fatta con farina e spinaci. Frullare farina e spinaci fino a ottenere un impasto compatto, tagliare piccoli pezzi direttamente in acqua bollente e condire con pesto di spinaci, noci, parmigiano, aglio, olio e sale.

TITLE: Tramezzini al salmone
DESCRIPTION: Tramezzini farciti con pane morbido, formaggio spalmabile, maionese, uovo sodo, capperi, cipolla, salmone affumicato, sale e pepe. Mescolare la crema, spalmarla sul pane, aggiungere verdura e tagliare in diagonale.

TITLE: Cookies burro di arachidi e marmellata
DESCRIPTION: Cookies con burro di arachidi, burro morbido, zucchero di canna, farina, tuorli, sale, bicarbonato e marmellata. Lavorare burri e zucchero, aggiungere tuorli e farina, incorporare marmellata e cuocere in forno.

TITLE: Melanzane ripiene senza uova
DESCRIPTION: Melanzane ripiene leggere con aglio, prezzemolo, basilico, capperi, tonno, olio extravergine, olive, pepe nero, peperoncino e pangrattato opzionale. Svuotare e farcire le melanzane, poi cuocere fino a gratinatura.

TITLE: Rolls de espinaca
DESCRIPTION: Rolls saludables con espinaca, huevos, almidon de maiz, leche, aceite de oliva, sal y pimienta. Preparar la masa verde, cocinarla fina y rellenar con zanahoria, tomate, choclo y palta.

TITLE: Strangolapreti ricotta e spinaci con speck
DESCRIPTION: Gnocchi tradizionali con ricotta, spinaci e speck croccante, serviti con burro e salvia. Preparare l'impasto morbido, formare gli strangolapreti, lessarli e saltarli con il condimento.

TITLE: Salade de poulet au curry
DESCRIPTION: Salade zero dechet avec chair de poulet, oeuf dur, mayonnaise, curry indien, jus de citron, herbes hachees, salade et pain. Effilocher le poulet, lier avec la sauce curry et garnir un bun grille.

TITLE: Magret de canard seche au piment Niora
DESCRIPTION: Magret de canard seche avec salage par impregnation, epices et piment Niora legerement fume. Emballer serre ou sous vide, laisser maturer puis secher selon la methode indiquee.

TITLE: Tahdig Persian rice
DESCRIPTION: Tahdig with basmati rice, butter, olive oil, water, saffron and salt. Rinse and soak the rice, parboil until the outside softens, then steam with fat and saffron to form a crisp golden crust.

TITLE: Fresh tomato salsa
DESCRIPTION: Fresh tomato salsa with ripe tomatoes, onion, jalapenos, lime, olive oil, cilantro, cumin, salt and pepper. Pulse the ingredients in a food processor until chunky and bright.

TITLE: Maryland crab dip
DESCRIPTION: Crab dip with softened cream cheese, mayo, sour cream, whole grain mustard, Old Bay hot sauce, Old Bay seasoning, roasted garlic, smoked cheddar, Gruyere, lemon and lump crab. Mix and bake until hot and bubbling.

TITLE: Buffalo chicken dip
DESCRIPTION: Buffalo chicken dip with seasoned chicken breasts, smoked Gouda, cheddar, cream cheese, ranch or blue cheese, roasted garlic and chives. Cook the chicken, shred it, mix with cheeses and bake until melted.

TITLE: Spaghetti with zucchini cream and clams
DESCRIPTION: Spanish pasta recipe with spaghetti, zucchini cream, clams, chili, olive oil and seasoning. Cook the pasta, blend or cook down the zucchini into a sauce, combine with clams and finish warm.

TITLE: Broccoli and egg breakfast patties
DESCRIPTION: Healthy breakfast with broccoli, onion, cheese, egg whites and egg yolks. Blanch and chop broccoli, mix with onion, cheese and whites, shape patties, add yolks in the center and cook covered.

TITLE: Turkey legs and potatoes in the oven
DESCRIPTION: Spanish oven dish with turkey legs, potatoes, onion, green pepper, olive oil and a parsley, thyme, paprika, garlic and tomato paste marinade. Roast wrapped turkey with seasoned potatoes until tender and browned.

TITLE: Gnocchi with textured soy and pisto
DESCRIPTION: Vegetarian Spanish-style dish with gnocchi, textured soy, vegetable stock, white wine, pisto, garlic, turmeric, pepper, thyme and parsley. Hydrate soy in seasoned broth, add pisto, then cook gnocchi briefly.

TITLE: Healthy banana oat dessert
DESCRIPTION: No-flour dessert with oats, almonds, peanuts, raisins, prunes, cranberries, sesame, cocoa, banana, honey and dark chocolate. Mix chopped nuts and fruit with mashed banana, bake, then glaze with chocolate.

TITLE: Individual chocolate cold dessert
DESCRIPTION: Cold Spanish dessert with chocolate cream, chocolate chip cookies, chantilly mix, soy drink or milk, chocolate sprinkles and homemade strawberry jam. Layer cream, cookies, jam and whipped topping in small glasses.

TITLE: Shrimp shumai
DESCRIPTION: Shumai dumplings with shrimp, dried scallops, bamboo shoots, green onion, egg white, ginger, potato starch, cooking wine, sesame oil and wrappers. Mix filling until sticky, form cups and steam.

TITLE: Individual chocolate cheesecake
DESCRIPTION: No-bake style individual cheesecake with cream cheese, dessert chocolate, sweetener, crackers and optional cream. Melt chocolate, combine with softened cheese, portion into glasses and chill.

TITLE: Sweet potato chips
DESCRIPTION: Healthy chips made with sweet potato, ginger powder, black pepper, olive oil, salt, herbs and garlic powder. Slice thinly, season with oil and spices, bake until crisp and cool fully.

TITLE: Cuban-style pork mojo
DESCRIPTION: Caribbean pork recipe with pork shoulder or loin head, sour orange or orange-lime juice, garlic and seasonings. Marinate, slow cook or confit, then fry or brown for a crisp outside.

TITLE: Sea bass fillets with lemon and potatoes
DESCRIPTION: Spanish fish tray bake with sea bass fillets, potatoes, onion, lemon, garlic, parsley, olive oil, salt and pepper. Layer potatoes and onion, add fish and lemon, then bake until tender.

TITLE: Sarmale cabbage rolls
DESCRIPTION: Romanian cabbage rolls with mixed pork and beef mince, round rice, onion, paprika and dried herbs cooked slowly in tomato sauce. Fill cabbage leaves and simmer until tender.

TITLE: Apple cottage cheese buns
DESCRIPTION: No-yeast buns with apple, egg, salt, sugar, cottage cheese, oil, lemon zest, lemon juice, flour, baking soda, cinnamon and sugar topping. Mix soft dough, portion and bake.

TITLE: No-knead no-yeast quick pizza
DESCRIPTION: Fast pizza with eggs, sour cream, kefir or mayonnaise, flour, baking powder and salt. Mix batter, spread on parchment, add toppings and bake until golden.

TITLE: Sausage and cheese lavash roll-ups
DESCRIPTION: Quick snack with lavash bread, sausages, grated cheese, eggs, mayonnaise, dill, salt and oil. Spread egg-cheese filling on lavash, wrap sausages and fry until crispy.

TITLE: Date and nut chocolate candies
DESCRIPTION: No-bake sweets with dates, peanuts or nuts, sesame seeds and dark chocolate. Toast nuts and sesame, blend dates, shape bars, fill with melted chocolate and slice after setting.

TITLE: Stir fried glass noodles japchae
DESCRIPTION: Japchae-style glass noodles with vegetables, spinach and thin egg garnish. Prep vegetables separately, blanch spinach, stir fry each component and combine with noodles and seasoning.

TITLE: Zucchini pisto with tuna and octopus
DESCRIPTION: Spanish mixed dish with zucchini, onion, peppers, garlic, tomato sauce, tuna slices, cooked octopus, paprika, salt and olive oil. Cook the vegetable pisto, add tuna and serve with paprika octopus.

TITLE: Microwave rice with vegetables
DESCRIPTION: Easy microwave rice with vegetables, water or stock cube, seasoning and olive oil. Combine rice, liquid and vegetables in a microwave-safe dish and cook until the rice absorbs the liquid.

TITLE: Sausages wrapped in crepes
DESCRIPTION: Simple snack with cooked chicken sausages, frozen crepes, lactose-free cheese slices, sweet mustard, ketchup and light mayonnaise. Fill, roll and heat until the cheese melts.

TITLE: Quinoa with salmon asparagus and mango
DESCRIPTION: Colorful quinoa dish with salmon, asparagus, mango, water, salt and olive oil. Cook quinoa, prepare salmon and asparagus, then combine with mango for a fresh lunch bowl.

TITLE: Lentil soup with lemon
DESCRIPTION: Arabic lentil soup with brown lentils, onions, potato, zucchini, lemon juice, dried mint, cumin, garlic and salt. Saute onion, add lentils and vegetables, pressure cook, then finish with lemon, cumin and garlic.

TITLE: Caramelized popcorn
DESCRIPTION: Arabic sweet popcorn with popcorn kernels, sugar and vegetable oil. Pop the corn, melt sugar with oil into caramel, turn off heat and coat popcorn until evenly glazed.
